caption: The drawing depicts a standing figure on a brown oval base. The figure has light pinkish skin and short black hair, and is wearing a cream-colored, fan-shaped headdress. Around the neck is a simple black necklace with small circles. The figure is bare-chested, with two pink nipples and visible red shading on the cheeks. The arms are bent, with yellow gloves covering both hands, which are clasped together at the midsection. The lower half of the figure is dressed in a long, flowing skirt with vertical blue and green stripes, adorned with wavy and curling blue patterns, and accentuated with bands of green, yellow, and blue near the hem. The background is an off-white color with no additional objects or details.
title: Santa (One of Eight Virgins) Front View
